_comment: Title-complete generation and validation. Curated banks live beside this file (songs.json, films.json, tv.json).

difficultyLevels.easy: very famous titles almost everyone knows
difficultyLevels.standard: well-known titles a person of that era would recall

eraLines.any: Era: any era (prefer mid-20th century through early 2000s).

categoryLines.custom: Category focus: "{category}" — use well-known song, film, or TV titles that clearly fit this theme.

blankRule: Remove exactly ONE distinctive content word and replace it with a blank.

locale.otherLine: - Prefer cultural references familiar in locale '{locale}'.
